The reflection on the surface below is overly perfect and symmetrical. While physically possible on a glossy table, AI generators often create 'mirror' reflections that lack the slight distortion or fading expected in real photography, giving it a synthetic feel.

To verify the continuity of the pink piping and ensure the edges are sharp and not bleeding into the white background.
To assess the realism of the lighting, shadows, and the potential artificiality of the reflection.

focus_areas: Edge sharpness of the pink trim against the white background
Coherence of the printed owl design (no melting limbs or extra eyes)
Realism of the floor reflection (opacity and blur gradient)
Texture consistency of the fabric body
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'reflection' artifact. In AI images, reflections are often too clean or mirror-perfect. Check if the reflection opacity fades correctly with distance. Also, inspect the owl graphic for any subtle anatomical errors (e.g., asymmetric wings or merged talons) which are common generation failures.
